mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 49 degrees. The moon is currently in its First Quarter phase, and we have a treat for the skywatchers: the ISS will be visible tonight starting at 5:44 PM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward Madison near Home Depot, reaching high in the sky.

In city news, the Plan Commission is set to review various projects at their December 7th meeting, including site plans for Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Municipal Court is reminding residents that while many tickets can be paid online or by phone, certain cases like O W I charges require a personal appearance.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music at Bailey's Run happening today. Looking ahead, you can check out yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, followed by a variety of trivia nights and live performances happening throughout the rest of the week at local favorites.
Looking back at the weekly report, on October 23rd, officers contacted two 13-year-olds riding eMotos on Ashton Drive and cited their parents for allowing minors to operate a motor vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is the refreshing Mint Explosion. Culver's is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM, so make sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
